bio: A lively establishment, where it is fun to have a meal! This is partly down to the stylish atmosphere and the adept service from the pleasingly laid-back front-of-house team, but it is first and foremost thanks to the tasty and honest Asian cuisine, prepared for you by the Asian-born chef-owner duo. They will treat you to beautifully authentic street food and soul food dishes... the task of choosing is not an easy one. Sharing is also an option if you would like to try more of a variety. Tip: The cocktails are fantastic too!...
